panel.prompt: Create ONE game UI asset, square panel for nine-slice stretching, 1024x1024. Reference image is STYLE ONLY: Eterno Retorno gothic pixel-art title screen, near black stone and weathered silver iron, muted violet undertones, thorn-like gothic corner ornaments. NO gold, NO wood, NO text, NO symbols in the center. Panel fills canvas edge-to-edge with no outer empty margin. Thin straight continuous frame around all four sides, subtle symmetrical thorn ornamentation fully confined to corner squares of 100x100px. Straight middle sections stretch cleanly. Inside is completely opaque almost uniform charcoal black #101017 with extremely subtle stone grain, no illustration or glow. Pixel-art crafted frame edges, restrained silver-grey highlights, readable UI framing matching reference. This is a production empty UI panel, not a mockup. All border ornament inside canvas. Center 800x800 unobstructed dark fill.
